L1-COMPOUND-STOPWORDS-V1.title: Strip stopwords before lesson matching
L1-COMPOUND-STOPWORDS-V1.text: Strip stopwords from the query before lesson matching. Stopwords (to, is, when, what, does, ...) carry no retrieval signal; matching them lets long generic notes outrank the note that actually teaches the queried concept.

L2-COMPOUND-DERIVED-SYNONYMS-V1.title: Refined retrieval lesson with derived synonyms compounding
L2-COMPOUND-DERIVED-SYNONYMS-V1.text: Refined retrieval: strip stopwords (L1), then expand the query with synonym mappings derived from L1's measured failures: remove->delete. Mappings were kept only with positive marginal gain on the full benchmark (greedy forward selection).
